stops.name: Parque Gran Hacienda
stops.story: Look around you at Parque Gran Hacienda. You stand in a park. It is a place for leisure. Take a look at the space around you. You can see the park extends in several directions. It is open for you to enjoy.

stops.name: Parque Mágica
stops.story: Look around you at Parque Mágica. You are standing in a park. Take a look at the space before you. It is a place for leisure. You see open ground. This is Parque Mágica.

stops.name: Juventud 2000
stops.story: Look around you at this open space. You see a recreation ground. People use it for multiple sports. It is called Juventud 2000. Take a look at the area around you; it is a place for recreation and sport.

stops.name: Jardines de Cecyte Xochimilco
stops.story: Look around you at the Jardines de Cecyte Xochimilco. You are standing in a park. Take a look at the open space before you. This is a place for leisure. You can see the park extends out from where you stand. Enjoy the Jardines de Cecyte Xochimilco.

stops.name: Parque Hacienda del Real
stops.story: Look around you at Parque Hacienda del Real. You are standing in a park. Take a look at the space around you. You see an area designated for leisure. It is a place for recreation. Enjoy the park.
